entries.content_plain:
Introduction

 David consults Nathan about building a temple for God, 1Chr 17:1 , 1Chr 17:2 . God sends him an answer by Nathan, informing him that Solomon shall build the house, 1Chr 17:3-14 . David receives the Divine purpose with humility and joy, and gives God praise, 1Chr 17:15-27 . 

 Verse 1 

 Now it came to pass - See every thing recorded in this chapter amply detailed in the notes on 2Sam 7:1 (note), etc.
